answer_1.quote: We address reproducibility of human evaluations in NLG, a field in which they play a central role ...

answer_4.quote: In an era dominated by metrics and leaderboards, human evaluation can be an afterthought, often carried out and reported in a slapdash way ... 33% of evaluations use fewer than 10 evaluators ... the survey also revealed that the roughly 170 papers reviewed often provide woefully inadequate information about human evaluations: numbers of evaluators, experimental design, the quality criterion assessed ...
